design_axis: APP VISUAL real Production-scope persistent Character management task flow
bounded_question: Can persistent Characters be reached and managed beyond the current Scene inside the COMP shell while preserving Scene membership/selection, off-Scene reality and persistent identity without creating a permanent People silo or casting/Performer mechanics?

close_reconciliation.effect: No contradiction at construction close. Website remains app-UI-frozen and Engineering adds no Product semantics that alter Character-management authority.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1

local_result.summary: Whole-Production Character management now opens as temporary Production-scope depth from the real Shaping origin. Mira is locally selected while explicitly Off-Scene, Julian remains the stored Scene-12 selection, Niko can hold independent keyboard focus, and Back/Close restore the originating trigger without changing Scene participation.

390px sequential management layout preserving origin, status and detail

interaction: management activation succeeds in both themes while Shaping hides

constrains: Future Production-scope Character management preserves explicit off-Scene state, Scene-membership non-implication, persistent Character identity, local management versus stored Scene selection, focus independence and exact return unless a named successor supersedes them.

explicit_non_authority: No Scene add/remove/participation controls or membership mutation semantics.
No casting, Performer/provider assignment, availability or model semantics.
No final Character data schema or Product commit/save/undo contract.
No Bellweather placement, bespoke domain icons, motion/Stage successor, production tokens, native implementation, shipping or Store authority.
